headline: Twelve straight wins and the Sox are absolutely on fire
morning_brew: Twelve straight wins. My heart can barely take it, but the energy at Fenway is wicked electric right now. Rallies are becoming the calling card of this group, and watching them claw back after falling behind early against Tampa Bay was the kind of grit we haven't seen in this ballpark in a long time. It feels like every guy in the lineup is picking each other up, and that confidence is contagious enough to catch a cold in the dugout.

Wilyer Abreu is playing out of his mind, providing the kind of power that shifts the momentum of an entire series. I am not gonna say we have the division title locked up, but the way this team is fighting back is a massive statement to the rest of the league. I am making another deposit into the Duck Boat fund, and I am not even gonna apologize for how optimistic I am gettin'.

My mother called me after the final out and just said they finally look like a real ballclub again. She has watched this team since before I was born and she is usually the toughest critic I know, definitely harsher than my neighbor Rick on his best day. If she is impressed, then we really do have something cooking. I am just gonna enjoy this ride while it lasts and hope the hot streak carries right into the next series at Fenway.

news_digest.headline: Red Sox's win streak hits 12 after four-run rally vs. Rays
news_digest.dans_take: Twelve games in a row is no fluke and this team is playing like they could beat the 1927 Yankees.

trend_watch.dans_take: The man is locked in and making every pitcher pay for leaving one over the plate like it's his job.

trend_watch.trend: Working through traffic to lock down the save
trend_watch.dans_take: My blood pressure spiked with those walks, but he found a way to finish the job.
This is the kind of run that defines a season and turns every cynic in Boston into a believer.
